name: @bear-harness/desktop
description: Cyber Bear desktop app — SolidJS renderer on an Electron shell.
author: fltb

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit
scripts.package:mac: node scripts/validate-product-config.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.ts --mac dmg zip --universal
scripts.package:win: node scripts/validate-product-config.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.ts --win nsis zip --x64
scripts.package:linux: node scripts/validate-product-config.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.ts --linux AppImage deb --x64
